intro: Gerber High Performance (HP) vinyl is specially formulated by 3M to adhere to uneven surfaces and perform for five-to-eight years, even in harsh exterior environments. Pressure-sensitive adhesive promotes ease of cutting, weeding, and application. HP vinyl is available with two liners: 220 features 78-pound kraft paper, while 225 is lined with transparent synthetic.

tabs.title: 180mC Controltac Film
tabs.html:
3MTM ControltacTM Film with microComply Adhesive Series 180mC, sold by Gerber

High performance 2 mil gloss vinyl which features an improved, non-visible, pressure-activated adhesive to simplify application of graphics on flat, corrugated and riveted surfaces. Pigmented adhesive provides maximum opacity. Six- to seven-year exterior life.

Suggested Devices:Vinyl Cutting , Thermal Transfer
Available Colors:White
Available Widths:15″ Punched
Available Lengths:10 yards, 50 yards

tabs.title: 225 High Performance
tabs.html:
High performance 2 mil cast vinyl film on a transparent synthetic liner. Expressly formulated for Gerber. Transparent, synthetic liner is moisture-resistant and offers superior registration for multi-color plotter applications and on Gerber thermal transfer printed graphics. Clear pressure-sensitive adhesive allows for production of attractive two-way markings. Excellent durability with five- to eight-year exterior life.
